cells.quote: Similarly, DNA methylation is a potent stabiliser of gene expression, and enhancing DNA methylation by inhibiting DNA methyltransferases or knocking out DNMT3a potently inhibits LTP.
cells.note: The review reports an effect on LTP, not a printed effect size or a direct memory-storage outcome.

O.outcome_detail: conversion of early LTP to late LTP and promotion of long-term memory formation

cells.quote: HDAC inhibitors can convert E-LTP to L-LTP in vitro and promote long-term memory formation, particularly when given just prior to LTP induction or learning.
cells.note: The study text does not specify the assignment method, participant or animal age, expertise, duration, or effect size.
